tools.name: tg_send
tools.description: Send one line to the person on Telegram, through the bot this pet is connected to. With no chatId it answers the chat that last wrote to you.

chatId.description: Optional. The chat to send to; defaults to the last one that wrote.

summary.zh: 通过 Telegram bot 给人发一句话。
summary.en: Send one line to the person on Telegram.

description.zh: 人在 Telegram 上发来的一条消息（只来自 allow 名单里的会话）。
description.en: One message the person sent on Telegram, from an allow-listed chat only.
